headline: BigHat reports AI-assisted optimization of two antibody families in an automated lab
summary: BigHat’s October 27 report describes a collaboration in which an Anthropic researcher and Claude worked with BigHat scientists and an automated laboratory to optimize two therapeutic-antibody families. BigHat says it synthesized and tested 1,232 antibodies across seven iterative rounds in ten weeks; Anthropic’s account of the same collaboration gives a total of about 1,010 variants. Neither account explains the difference. BigHat reports selected binding, solution-stability and aggregation improvements. These are company-reported results without independent reproduction; they do not establish therapeutic efficacy or an isolated model contribution.
